stock_config.reason: stock = upstream's predict preset as shipped (use_deepspeed_evo_attention true on CUDA, openfold3/projects/of3_all_atom/config/model_config.py:115) with the two documented settings that make it faster on this stack: the cuEquivariance triangle kernels on (cuequivariance_torch is in the pinned stack; the kernels take precedence over DS4Sci for triangle attention, openfold3/core/model/primitives/attention.py) and Lightning's bf16-mixed precision (pl_trainer_args.precision: the trunk, MSA module, template embedder and confidence heads under bf16 autocast; the diffusion rollout stays in upstream's fp32 region) — passed as --runner-yaml on the stock arm and as the base of exact; under the det recipe (--det 1|2) both arms run det_file, the same with the DS4Sci attention off (that kernel is not run-to-run deterministic), and exact is bitwise identical to it
